freeze.contract_scope: Freeze V2 experiment identities and decision rules before any V2 empirical result is produced.
freeze.mutation_rule: Any change to a frozen field or bound preparation/implementation revision requires reopening #81 and a fresh independent successor activation audit before empirical execution.

longitudinal_metrics_binding.materiality: Use the #78 zero-tolerance directionality policy for longitudinal regression/improvement classification; do not introduce V2-local metric substitutes.

frozen_v1_control.selection_rationale: Within the final governed Phase-D V1 context, the zero-return naive baseline outperformed both HistGB and Ridge on RMSE, so it is the strongest V1 control for the primary V2 comparison.

context_identity.target_timestamp_semantics: next-session selected-contract within-contract settlement log return; cross-contract returns prohibited

frozen_execution_rules.execution_code_revision_rule: Each child preparation/specification revision and exact child implementation revision are frozen separately. Result-affecting source manifests are frozen with the child implementation; later integrated runtime repository SHAs are recorded separately and are valid only when the recomputed source manifest equals the #81-bound child manifest. No post-result code mutation is permitted.

leakage_guard.target_construction: next-session selected-contract within-contract settlement log return; cross-contract returns prohibited

coverage_thresholds.indicator_family_failure_rule: If any required W/S/C/V/P/L feature is unavailable on a fit/scored row, I-ALL is invalid and no reduced aggregate may substitute as the primary #83 challenger.
coverage_thresholds.kronos_failure_rule: Any missing/non-finite selected OHLCV context or missing governed prediction blocks the run.

material_improvement_rule.pairwise_requirement: challenger RMSE must be strictly lower than every required comparator RMSE
material_improvement_rule.no_epsilon_added: No V2-local numeric epsilon is invented beyond the #78 zero-tolerance metric policy.

uncertainty_significance_rule.bh_input_rule: Only the primary moving-block-bootstrap p_value enters the prespecified BH family.

robustness_rule.chronological_period_assignment: split the ordered primary OOS scored-row sequence into three contiguous periods with sizes differing by at most one row; earlier periods receive any remainder row before later periods

regime_definition.formula: arithmetic mean of range_pct=(high-low)/close over the 20 selected-contract daily bars ending at and including the prediction-cutoff bar
regime_definition.point_in_time_rule: every contributing OHLC bar must be available at or before the prediction cutoff; no target or post-cutoff value may enter regime assignment
regime_definition.roll_rule: range_pct is computed within each selected contract daily bar, so no cross-contract return is formed at a roll boundary
regime_definition.thresholds: empirical 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of finite initial-train trailing_range20_mean values, computed once before OOS scoring and then held fixed
regime_definition.boundary_rule: low if signal <= q1; medium if q1 < signal <= q2; high if signal > q2

84.rule: Fusion architecture/combination rule remains owned by #84 and must be frozen before fusion results; #84 may not redefine #81 target, metrics, comparators, seeds, leakage, cost, multiplicity, or stop rules.

empirical_release_gate.rule: Successor audit #142 independently passed the exact corrected #81/#83 authority. #83 is released only for PR #117 preparation commit 2c2b260971739f6dc39437614d769dea57fe58e2, PR #140 implementation head 6e36173dd32eafe438557ac411a85257b2f08479, and source manifest 1464b8c5f7558fe727f0ed6c3674ffc96b1de164b50ac8696790da2759ecbc83; #84/#85 remain unauthorized.

stop_failure_criteria.condition: Successor audit #142, preserving lineage to completed historical audit #88, has not passed against this exact frozen #81 contract and bound child preparation/implementation revisions/source manifests.
Any frozen target/dataset/vintage/OOS/protocol/split/baseline/PIT identity changes without a separately governed non-comparable experiment identity.
Any input violates the frozen availability cutoff, target construction, fold-local transform rule, or ex-ante robustness-regime rule.
The common statistical evaluator manifest, source hashes, primary BH p-value semantics, or secondary diagnostic role differ from the frozen #81 binding before or after empirical execution.
A required primary-candidate input or governed prediction fails its 1.0 coverage rule.
A prespecified multiplicity-family member is missing/invalid or family membership would be changed after results; fail closed rather than shrinking or regrouping the family.
A negative/null result would trigger post-hoc feature, model, seed, threshold, horizon, multiplicity, or provider search inside the same experiment.
#84 later fails the preregistered material/robust increment gate against any required comparator.
